overall_assessment: The cross-repository contract release train and ecosystem lock architecture specified in integration/release-train.json, integration/ecosystem-lock.json, contracts/compatibility/schema-surface-0.1.0-alpha.1.json, and docs/release-train.md establishes a rigorous, fail-closed multi-repository coordination framework. The release train coordinates three independent repositories with a strictly pinned and contiguous producer-consumer promotion order: edithatogo/citeweft (promotion_order: 1, document-evidence producer), edithatogo/searchright (promotion_order: 2, systematic-search orchestrator and shared-kernel producer), and edithatogo/sourceright (promotion_order: 3, bibliographic verification downstream consumer). Automatic promotion is unconditionally disabled across the release train (automatic_promotion: false), the ecosystem lock (automatic_updates: false), and across all six discrete lifecycle stages: contract (contracted), consumer_fixture (fixture_proven), compiler (compiler_verified), downstream_canary (fixture_proven), release_candidate (fixture_proven), and promotion (publicly_accepted). The ecosystem lock integration/ecosystem-lock.json explicitly fixes observed component identities, SHA-256 digests for contracts and public package policies, and exact Git revisions for all seven ecosystem members (including citeweft at 8c8932976250f9ca91c2bbda28ed68eeb191fa42 and sourceright at 89f3d1a08037057160700df5bba319a64500b791). Schema surface baseline contracts/compatibility/schema-surface-0.1.0-alpha.1.json indexes 74 JSON schemas and 3 interface surfaces (WIT, OpenAPI, server.json) with cryptographic hashes, preventing undetected interface drift. Python checkers scripts/check_release_train.py, scripts/sync_ecosystem_lock.py --check, and scripts/sync_schema_surface.py --check, alongside unit tests in tests/test_cross_repository_release_train_governance.py, pass deterministically network-free.
verified_invariants: contiguous producer-consumer promotion order: citeweft (1) -> searchright (2) -> sourceright (3) enforced without gaps or permutation
strict default-deny automation: automatic_promotion is false on the release train, automatic_updates is false on the ecosystem lock, and all 6 stages specify automatic: false
pinned ecosystem component identities: 7 components locked to exact commit hashes and digests; searchright revision explicitly reserved for release receipt recording
exact schema surface tracking: 74 JSON schemas and 3 interface specifications (WIT, OpenAPI, server.json) verified by SHA-256 digests
six contiguous release stages: contract -> consumer_fixture -> compiler -> downstream_canary -> release_candidate -> promotion with increasing evidence requirements
deterministic static checkers: scripts/check_release_train.py, scripts/sync_ecosystem_lock.py --check, and scripts/sync_schema_surface.py --check pass cleanly network-free

findings.description: Multi-repository promotion order and non-promoting stages are verified at the source contract level; compiler verification across producer and consumer repositories remains an open operational gate.
findings.recommendation: Preserve open gate T32-G-COMPILER-SUITE until compiled contract suites run in CiteWeft, Searchright, and Sourceright.

findings.description: The release train manifest cleanly isolates control surfaces by linking integration/ecosystem-lock.json, contracts/compatibility/schema-surface-0.1.0-alpha.1.json, and release/public-packages.json as independent verifiable assets.
findings.recommendation: Maintain modular validation of each control surface within pre-commit and scheduled drift verification workflows.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Pinned producer-consumer promotion order (CiteWeft -> Searchright -> Sourceright) and ecosystem lock verified in source contracts and deterministic checkers.
Default-deny promotion across all 6 stages, fail-closed ecosystem lock, and contract surface compatibility baseline verified.

limitations: Source-verified release train contracts and ecosystem lock baseline only; compiler-verified builds across all three repositories and live candidate promotion receipts remain open gates.
